conditions.explanation: Pain around the front of the kneecap that worsens with stairs and prolonged sitting.
conditions.whatItMeans: The kneecap is not tracking cleanly through its groove during knee bend.
conditions.howToManage: Strengthen the quadriceps and hip abductors; reduce deep-flexion loading for now.
nextSteps: See a physical therapist if symptoms persist beyond two weeks
Avoid deep squats and stair descent while symptomatic

overallSummary: Findings are most consistent with patellofemoral pain syndrome.
disclaimerText: This is educational information, not medical advice.
